label: Clean presets
command: cmake --build --preset debug --target clean && cmake --build --preset release --target clean

label: Run tests
command: cmake --preset debug && cmake --build --preset debug && ctest --preset debug

label: Run clang-tidy
command: cmake --preset debug && cmake --build --preset debug && clang-tidy -p build/debug --config-file=.clang-tidy src/*.cpp tests/*.cpp

label: Run clang-format
command: find include src tests -type f \( -name '*.cpp' -o -name '*.hpp' \) -exec clang-format -i {} +
